---
applyTo: "src/i18n/**"
---

# Rules for language files

- `de.json` and `en.json` MUST contain exactly the same keys (flat, dot-separated, e.g. `sim.s1.titel`).
- Placeholders use single braces: `"Hallo, {name}!"` — filled by `t(key, { name })`.
- Never rename or delete a key without updating every usage; `t()` falls back to showing the raw key on screen.
- After every change run `npm run check:i18n`.
